book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Gita Bonchchon Yerusalaame Gelides
Istti Yerusalaame matan Dabrazayte zuma bolla diza Betefaage geetettizaso gakkida mala Yesusi bana kaallizaytappe nam7ata kiittides.
«Hanno intte matan diza gutayo biidi intte hee gakkida mala issi hare dizaara ba gutteyra qashetta dishin intte demmana. Birshidi haa taakko ekki yiite.
Oonikka inttena, ‹Ays hayssaththo ooththeetii?› giikko ‹Goday istta koyees› giite; inttena oychchizaadey heerakka yeddana.
Iza kaallizayti Yesusi isttas yootida mala ooththida.
Hareyo izi gutteyra ehidi ba may7o istta bolla woththiin izikka hareta toggides.
Deraappe dariza baggay ba may7o oge bolla miccides; bagga asay miththa boncco duuththi duuththi oge bolla aaththi aaththi yeggides.
Izappe sinththara biza dereynne guyera kaalliza dereykka ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi,
Izi Yerusalaame gelida mala katama asay wuri, «Hayssi oonee?» giidi yark yarkides.
Iza kaallidi yida derezikka, «Hayssi Galila giddon diza Naazireteppe yida Nabe Yesusa gidennee?» gides.
Yesusi Xoossa Keeththan Zal7e Zal7iza Asaa Gooddides

Hessafe guye Yesusi Xoossa Keeth gelidi Xoossa Keeththaa kare giddon gaaththan bayzizaytanne shammizayta gooddides. Miish laammizayta xaraphpheezatanne haraphphe bayzizayta oyde shiri shiri yeggidi, « ‹Ta Keeththay Woosa Keeththe geetettees› geetettidi xaafettides; intte qasse bonqqizayta gongolo histtideta» gides.
Ayfe qooqetanne tohoy silida asata Yesusaakko Xoossa Keeththe ehida. Izikka istta paththides.

Gido attiin qeeseta halaqatinne Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti izi ooththida malaatata be7idayssaninne guuththa nayti, «Woze kawo, galatay Dawite naas gido!» giidi waassizayssa siyida gishshas daro hanqettida.
Isttika Yesusa, «Hayti nayti gizayssa siyay?» gida; Yesusikka isttas, «Ee siyadis; nayta doonaninne dhammiza qeeri nayta doonan tani galata giigsadis gizaso mulerakka nababi erekketii?» gides.
Istta yeggi aggidi he katamaappe kezidi Bitaaniya geetettizaso biidi heen aqides.
Ayfey Baynda Balase Miththiyo
Yesusi wonteththa gallas maalado guye katama simmishin iza gafisides.
Oge matan issi balase geetettiza mith be7idi gede izikko shiiqishin hayth xalalappe attiin ayfey bayndayssa be7idi, «Hiyappe guye ne bolla ayfey dooppo!» giin balase miththaya heerakka meladus.
Yesusa kaallizayti hessa be7idinne malalettidi, «Hanna balaseya waanada heerakka meladee?» gida.

Yesusikka istta, «Ta inttes tumu gays; inttes ammanoy diikkonne intte sidhontta aggiko balase miththay bolla hanidayssa mala xalala gidontta hayssa zumaa, ‹Hayssafe dhoqallettada duge abban gela› intte gidaakkoka izi gelana» gides.
Inttes ammanoy diikko intte woosan oychchida miish ubbaaka ekkana.
Yesusa Godateththa Gishshas Shiiqida Oysha
Yesusi Xoossa Keeththe gelidi tamaarsishin qeeseta halaqatinne dere cimati izakko shiiqidi, «Hayssa wursa oona shenen ooththay? Hayssa ooththanaas shene nees ooni immidee?» giidi iza oychchida.
Yesusikka isttas zaaridi, «Tanikka inttena issi miish oychchays; intte taas zaarikko tanikka hayta oona shenen ooththizaakko inttes yootana.
Yohannisa xinqatay awappe yidee? Saloppe yideyee? Asappee?» gides. Isttika, «Nu, ‹Saloppe yides› giikko, ‹Histtiin aazas ammanibeekketii?› gaana giidi ba giddon issoy issoy issaara zorettida.
Qasse nu, ‹Asappe› giikko, asay wurikka Yohannisa nabe giidi ammaniza gishshas nu babboos» gida.
Hessa gishshas Yesusas, «Nu erokko» giidi zaarida. Izikka isttas, «Hayta ta oona shenen ooththizaakko tanikka inttes yootikke» gides.
Nam7u Nayta Leemiso
Yesusi istta, «Inttes ay misatizee? Nam7u attuma nay diza issaadey dees; izikka koyro naazakko biidi, ‹Ta naazoo! Hach gede woyne miththaso baada ooththa› gides.
Naazi qasse, ‹Biikke!› giidinne guyeppe muuzottidi bides.
«Nam7anththo naazakka kaseyssaththoka, ‹Ba!› giin naazi, ‹Ero!› giidi bontta aggaagides.

Hayta nam7atappe aawaa shene poliday awayssee?» giidi oychchides. Isttika, «Koyro naaza!» gida. Yesusikka isttas, «Ta inttes tumu gays; qaraxa qanxxisizaytinne laymatizayti Salo Kawoteth inttefe sinththan gelana.

«Xammaqiza Yohannisi inttena xilloteththa oge bessanaas intteko yides shin intte izi gizayssa ammanibeekketa; gido attiin qaraxa qanxxisizaytinne laymatizayti gidikko ammanida; izi hanidayssa intte beyi simmidikka maaroteththan gelidi ammanibeekketa» gides.
Woyne Miththa Giddon Ooththiza Goshshanchcha Leemiso
«Hara leemisokka siyite; woyne miththi tokkizasohoy dizaadey he woynezas birda yuushshi aaththidi woyneza ayfe gum7anaas olla bookkides. Woyneza naaganaas miththa bolla shakko
giigsides. Hessafe guye gadeza woyne miththara goyizaytas kira immidi hara dere bides.
Boney gakkishin woyne miththaza ayfe ekkanaas ba ashkarata gadeza goyizaytakko yeddides.
Gadeza goyizayti ashkarata oykkidi issaa wodhida; issaa qasse shuchchan caddida.
Gadaa goday kaseytappe aadhdhiza hara ashkarata yeddides. Goyizayti ha7ikka kaseyta bolla ooththidayssa malakka istta bollaka polida.
Wurseththan oone erizay, ‹Istti iza bonchchanaakko› giidi ba naa aaththi yeddides.
Gido attiin gadaa goyizayti naaza be7ida mala, ‹Hayssi iza laattanayssako! Ane haa yiite; iza wodhidi gadaa laattoos› gida.
Naaza oykkidi woyney tokettidasozappe kare kessidi wodhida.
«Ero! Woyneza goday yiza wode he gadaa goyiza asata wosttana inttes misatizee?» gides.
Isttika, «Heyta iitata daro waayisi wodhidi woyney tokettiza gadaappe bessiza woyne ayfe wodera izas immiza hara goshshanchchatas gadaa kirasana» gi izas zaarida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Geeshsha Maxaafan,
«Hessa gishshas ta inttes Xoossa Kawoteththi inttefe ekettada ayfe ayfiza deretas imettana.
Hayssa shuchchaa bolla kundizay meqqana; shuchchay iza bolla wodhizaadeyka liiqana» gides.
Qeeseta halaqatinne Farsaaweti iza leemisoy istta gishshas gididayssa erida.
Gido attiin istti iza oykki qachchontta mala asay Yesusa nabe mala xeelliza gishshas babbida.

footnotes.text: Hareta toggides: Hareta toggides gizayssi NIV garsan dees; haray qasse tinbitey polettana mala hare gutte bolla uttides gees bagga geeshsha maxaafay.
Hoosa7inna Ibraaweta qaalara Hoosa7inna guussi, «Atoteth» «Nuna ashsharkkii!» guussa.
Shakko: Shakko issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan tuulla geetettees.
Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati taybo oyddu tammanne oyddu bolla dizayssa gujjeettes; qofazikka Luqaasa shempo 20:18 dizayssa misatees.
